description: Literal / regex code search (git grep, basic regex) across a repo at a ref. The dependable way to find code on this host — works on every repo, indexed or not. Optional scoping: `path` (a directory or file prefix, literal), `glob` (git pathspec glob such as `src/**/*.ts`, relative to `path` when both are given), `ignore_case`, and `files_only` (unique files with match counts instead of lines). Returns {owner, repo, ref, total, truncated, matches: [{file, line, text}]}, or with files_only {owner, repo, ref, total, totalMatches, truncated, files: [{file, count}]}. Omit `ref` for the default branch.

files_only.description: Return unique files with match counts instead of matching lines

glob.description: Only search files matching this git pathspec glob (e.g. **/*.test.ts); relative to `path` when both are given

limit.description: Max matches, or max files with files_only (default 50, max 200)

path.description: Only search under this repo-relative directory or file (literal prefix, e.g. src/lib)

ref.description: Branch / tag / sha (default: the repo's default branch)

name: gluecron_search_code
